subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of tertiary sector of employment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Education**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Education** is classified under the tertiary sector because it involves the provision of services rather than goods.
 
• The tertiary sector, also known as the **service sector**, includes industries that provide services to consumers and businesses.
 
• Examples of services in the tertiary sector include education, healthcare, retail, entertainment, and financial services.
 
• In the context of employment, the tertiary sector includes jobs such as teachers, doctors, bankers, and retail workers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tertiary Sector**

 
 
• The tertiary sector is one of the three sectors of the economy, the other two being the primary and secondary sectors.
 
• It is also known as the service sector because it involves the provision of services rather than the production of goods.
 
• The tertiary sector contributes significantly to the GDP of developed countries.
 
• Services provided in this sector include education, healthcare, finance, retail, entertainment, and more.
 
 
 
• **Primary Sector**
 
 
• The primary sector involves the extraction and harvesting of natural resources, such as agriculture, forestry, fishing, and mining.
 
• It forms the base of the economy in many developing countries.
 
• Jobs in this sector include farmers, fishermen, miners, and lumberjacks.
 
 
 
• **Secondary Sector**
 
 
• The secondary sector is concerned with manufacturing and processing activities.
 
• It involves the transformation of raw materials into finished goods.
 
• Examples include factories producing cars, textiles, and machinery.
 
• Jobs in this sector include factory workers, machinists, and production managers.
 
 
 
• **Examples of Tertiary Sector Jobs**
 
 
• **Teachers:** Provide education and training to students.
 
• **Doctors:** Offer medical services to patients.
 
• **Bankers:** Provide financial services such as loans and savings accounts.
 
• **Retail Workers:** Sell products and assist customers in stores.
